answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded ceramic-matrix credential whose ablation signature decays along a canyon of hardware-attested burn histories, making forgery as costly as faking re-entry heating. Validators sample this horizon of thermal traces and cross-check a willow of independent sensor logs, so duplicate personas collapse. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
